resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county booklet table and survey note and the Minnesota lookout list all give 1936. A 2010 Commons photo caption gives 1937. We follow the 1936 sources; the caption is a photographer's note.
The booklet table column reads 81 and the 1960 survey note gives an overall height of 90 feet. The units and measurement points differ, so no height is recorded.

sources.title: Hubbard County Fire Lookout Towers (tower booklet)

notes_for_editor: Built year 1936 is consistent across the county booklet and the state list; the 1937 Commons caption and the 1920s origin claim are unresolved. Height is disputed within the booklet (81 in the table, 90 feet in the 1960 note). No access, staffing or current-condition source was found; the record's access and staffing stay unknown. The booklet owner abbreviation Mn MFS is not spelled out in the part read, so agency is stated as an abbreviation. Record had no built event; one added. Summary and story say the tower stands above Frontenac Lake, per the booklet.
